headings.usage: Use for all page titles, widget titles, and hero metrics. It gives an institutional yet organic look.

body.usage: Use for all tabular data, chart labels, body text, and pricing numbers. Excellent for readability of Indian Rupees (₹) and data density.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale p-6, p-8 for containers)
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Deep Forest Green (#1E3F2A) sidebar with white text for high contrast navigation. Use a collapsible F-pattern layout.
grids_and_layouts.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px earthy borders (#E5E2DC). No glassmorphism on data containers (reduces refraction). Max border-radius 8px.

components_and_visual_enhancers.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure confidence bands in prediction charts use a soft fill opacity (e.g., 20%) of the primary trend color. Use a composite line chart + area chart.
components_and_visual_enhancers.pricing_recommendation_card: Apply 'The Tracing Beam' (dynamic subtle animated border via framer-motion) to highlight this as the AI-driven 'hero' element. Do NOT use purple.
components_and_visual_enhancers.data_tables: Dense style. Left-align most columns, right-align numeric pricing columns. Use alternating row colors very subtly or just clean 1px bottom borders.
components_and_visual_enhancers.ai_insights: Present plain-English AI text in a clean callout box with a subtle moss-green or pale sand background to indicate 'Insights'. Use an editorial typography touch here.

motion.interactions: Hover states must lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and darken border. Button clicks should scale down (scale-95).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease), do not use 'all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA minimum contrast. Prices must be minimum 3:1 against background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='predict-button').

hero_background.description: Cotton field at sunset. Use as a subtle, low-opacity (20%) blended background for the login/landing page to establish context.

user_avatar.description: Indian farmer traditional portrait. Use as a placeholder for the User Profile section.

3d_libraries_and_extras.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense, professional data/dashboard icons. (Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
3d_libraries_and_extras.animations: Use framer-motion for the Pricing Recommendation card entrance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo and IBM Plex Sans.
Install @phosphor-icons/react, recharts, framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Set up JWT Auth flow with mock data or real backend depending on state.
Build the dashboard F-pattern: Sidebar on left. Top row: Key metrics (Current Price, Trend). Main area: Prediction Chart. Right/Side area: AI Recommendation Card.
Use Recharts for the forecast chart (Historical + Future). Add an <Area> with lower/upper bound data for confidence bands, and a <Line> for the expected price.
Recommendation card must use color coding: HOLD (Ochre/Yellow), SELL (Terracotta/Red), WAIT (Ochre/Yellow) or BUY (Moss Green).
Do NOT use Space Grotesk. Do NOT use purple for AI features. AI should feel earthy and grounded, like an expert agronomist.
Ensure 'Indian Rupees only' is strictly followed (₹ symbol everywhere).
Do NOT center align the app container. Use clean F-pattern F-layout.
Ensure the header/top-nav doesn't have a transparent background if content scrolls under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid muddy gray transparency.
Do not apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container in CSS. It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use generous paddings.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar.
